text: 1. International Candidate should be a non-Chinese citizen, with the age between 18 and 25, healthy, with non-criminal record.2. International Candidate should have an educational background equal to or above high school graduation (or equivalent).3. English language requirements: for candidates from non-English spoken countries applying for EMI (English Mediated Instruction) programs, their minimum IELTS score should reach 6.0 or TOEFL score reach82 (IBT) (553 in written version or 217 in computer version), or equivalent.
